papers.title: Development and Characterization of Biogenic Hydroxyapatite Coatings Derived from Crab Shell Waste on Ti6Al4V Substrates
papers.abstract: In this work, we developed and characterized a hydroxyapatite (HA) ceramic coating derived from Ucides cordatus crab-shell waste and applied it onto Ti–Al–V titanium substrates for biomedical use. Substrate analysis confirmed an α + β two-phase microstructure and Rockwell C hardness of ~35 HRC; optical emission spectrometry indicated a non-conforming Ti–6Al–4V composition (Al slightly above and V slightly below ASTM F136-18 limits), with expected α-phase predominance. Aqueous synthesis of biogenic HA used CaO (from 800 °C calcined shells) reacted with β-tricalcium phosphate (β-Ca3(PO4)2), followed by deposition onto Ti–Al–V surfaces prepared with or without a thermochemical treatment that homogenized roughness (Ra ≈ 0.587 µm). The coatings were continuous, ~95–98 µm thick, and showed good qualitative adhesion. Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) revealed porous, nanocrystalline, acicular morphologies typical of biogenic apatite’s. Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) yielded Ca/P ≈ 1.85–1.88, while X-ray Fluorescence (XRF) indicated Ca-enrichment relative to stoichiometric HA. X-ray Diffraction (XRD) confirmed a predominantly hexagonal HA phase with high crystallinity. These results demonstrate a technically and environmentally feasible route to bioactive coatings using marine biowaste, aligning low-cost, local waste valorization with functional performance on titanium implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究蟹壳废料制备的羟基磷灰石涂层在Ti6Al4V基体上的开发与表征，与增材制造Ti6Al4V的机械或疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address mechanical or fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on coating synthesis from waste shells and coating characterization on a non-AM Ti6Al4V substrate, lacking any AM process, fatigue testing, or mechanical property evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发基于海洋生物废弃物的生物活性涂层用于钛基植入体
summary_zh.method: 从蟹壳制备羟基磷灰石并通过水相合成涂覆在Ti6Al4V基体上
summary_zh.result: 获得连续多孔的纳米晶涂层，Ca/P比约1.85-1.88，硬度约35 HRC
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EDS、XRF、XRD等表征涂层形貌、成分和物相

summary_en.motivation: To develop a bioactive coating from marine biowaste for titanium implant applications.
summary_en.method: Biogenic hydroxyapatite was synthesized from crab shell waste and deposited onto Ti6Al4V substrates with/without thermochemical pretreatment.
summary_en.result: Continuous nanocrystalline coatings ~95-98 µm thick with Ca/P ratio 1.85-1.88 and Rockwell C hardness ~35 HRC were obtained.
summary_en.validation: Coating morphology, composition, and phase were characterized by SEM, EDS, XRF, and XRD.

papers.title: Application of Machine Learning for Predicting Surface Roughness (Ra) in Abrasive Water Jet Machined Ti-6Al-4V MMCs
papers.abstract: In this work, Titanium aluminium alloy was machined using abrasive water jet machining (AWJM). Average surface roughness (Ra) evaluated on the machine holes used by the L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</inf> orthogonal array. Random forest (RF), Decision tree (DT), and XG Boost machine learning predicted algorithms were used for predicting the Ra machined holes on the Ti-6Al-4V metal matrix composites. This research reported that, DT has the lowest MAE (0.0260) and best R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (0.9626), demonstrating greater prediction accuracy. RF has a slightly higher MAE (0.0432) but lower MSE (0.1713) than DT, with a R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 0.9380. XGBoost has the lowest MSE (0.0837) and an excellent R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (0.9583), but its MAE (0.290) is much higher. Machining aluminium alloy metal matrix composites (MMCs) through Abrasive Water Jet Machining (AWJM) provides a sustainable, high-precision manufacturing approach. This technique supports Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure by promoting advanced and efficient machining technologies, and contributes to Responsible Consumption and Production by reducing environmental impact and encouraging cleaner, resource-efficient processing methods.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文涉及Ti-6Al-4V金属基复合材料的后处理（磨料水射流加工），但非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V，且未研究疲劳或力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address additive-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, focuses on MMCs and surface roughness prediction, with no evaluation of fatigue or mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测磨料水射流加工Ti-6Al-4V金属基复合材料的表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.method: 利用随机森林、决策树和XGBoost等机器学习模型预测表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.result: 决策树模型预测精度最高，MAE为0.0260，R²为0.9626。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量的表面粗糙度数据验证模型预测。

summary_en.motivation: The motivation is to develop a predictive model for surface roughness (Ra) of Ti-6Al-4V metal matrix composites machined by abrasive water jet machining (AWJM).
summary_en.method: Machine learning algorithms (Random Forest, Decision Tree, XGBoost) are applied to predict Ra based on an L18 orthogonal array of machining parameters.
summary_en.result: Decision Tree achieves the highest prediction accuracy with the lowest MAE (0.0260) and highest R² (0.9626).
summary_en.validation: Experimental Ra measurements from AWJM holes are used to validate the machine learning predictions.

papers.title: Exploring the Potential of Superplastic Forming of Ti-6Al-4V Tailored Machined Blanks for Lightweight Design
papers.abstract: Tailored machined blanks are sheets that feature heterogeneous thicknesses, allowing different areas of the final part to withstand distinct structural loads effectively. Conventional methods of tailoring the thickness of the final part, like chemical machining, are labour intensive processes that requires pre-masking and post cleaning of complex industrial component. The proposed method provides a cost-effective solution to manufacture light-weight components by simplifying the material removal compared to shaping intricate 3D parts. In fact, machining a flat blank is simpler than removing the material from complex 3D geometries. In this study, the feasibility of superplastically formed Ti-6Al-4V tailored machined blanks was analysed. Three industrial relevant design examples were developed for components forming with initial dissimilar thickness distributions. The results were examined through Finite Element (FE) simulation and experimentation. The FE simulations guided the design of these blanks. Two examples aimed to address the excessive thinning issue typically encountered with standard homogeneous thickness approaches, where specific regions in the part undergo maximum deformation. The blank designs were preserved with higher thicknesses in regions where maximum deformation was expected. The third example explored forming a structured pattern thickness distribution, incorporating thicker stiffeners covering the sheet in two perpendicular directions. Although the approaches differed, the goal of all three designs was to reduce the total weight of the part. The tailored blanks were manufactured via CNC machining from a 2.6 mm thick Ti-6Al-4V sheet, introducing variable thickness profiles. Subsequently, the blanks were superplastically formed in an SPF press. The successful forming of the parts demonstrated the feasibility of the tailored thickness blank approach that can enable the reduction in component weight. Also, this approach can help the industry to phase out chemical milling for the purpose of light-weighting and removing of excess material from post formed component. Importantly, the experimental trials showed good correlation with the FE simulations, emphasizing the crucial role of the FE tool in designing such components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究超塑性成形工艺，未涉及Ti-6Al-4V后处理对疲劳性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: No investigation of post-processing effect on fatigue or mechanical performance; no mechanical testing (fatigue/tensile), no microstructure analysis, no comparison of as-built vs. post-processed properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发成本效益高的轻量化Ti-6Al-4V部件成形方法
summary_zh.method: 通过数控加工制备变厚度板材，然后进行超塑性成形，并用有限元模拟指导设计
summary_zh.result: 成功成形三种设计案例，有限元与实验吻合良好，验证了可行性
summary_zh.validation: 超塑性成形实验与有限元模拟对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a cost-effective method for manufacturing lightweight Ti-6Al-4V components via superplastic forming of tailored machined blanks.
summary_en.method: CNC machining was used to create variable thickness sheets, which were then superplastically formed; finite element simulations guided the blank design.
summary_en.result: Three industrial design examples were successfully formed, showing good agreement between FE predictions and experiments, demonstrating feasibility for weight reduction.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated by comparing experimental forming trials with finite element simulations.
